children: Bank Negara Malaysia is expected to deliver a 25bp rate increase in 1H 2027, RHB senior economist Chin Yee Sian says in a note. The move would be a gradual step towards a more neutral policy stance, supported by resilient economic growth and aimed at preserving flexibility to respond to future shocks, she says. She expects the move to be driven by policy normalization rather than immediate inflationary pressures, with 2027 inflation forecast at 1.9%. Malaysia's economy is projected to expand 4.9% next year, supported by investment, resilient household spending, government support and technology-related exports. However, higher food and commodity prices could push inflation above expectations, RHB says. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
